_provenance.what: The CLAS Physics Database's answer to 'target = deuteron, quantity = any, all rows' -- the query BENCHMARK_PLAN.md sec. 4 row 10 asks for (machine-readable BONuS / EG1b tables).
_provenance.licence: no licence or terms of use are stated on the database pages (front page, search results, measurement pages all checked 2026-09-23); the rows below are a catalogue summary (facts) with attribution to the CLAS Physics Database (SINP MSU / JLab)
_provenance.per_quantity_queries: also run with tgt = deuteron and quantity = 56 (F2*P(Pt)), 57 (F2*P(Ps)), 58 (F2(x*,Q2)), 93 and 94 (d sigma/(dQ2 dPn [dOmega_n])), 173 (F2n/F2p), 13 (F2): every hit is inside the experiments listed here.
_provenance.verdict_for_row_10: BONuS (E-03-012, eid 135) is in the database as ONE measurement, E135M1: the ratio F2n/F2p vs W* (Baillie et al., PRL 108 (2012) 142001). There is NO BONuS spectator-momentum spectrum and no Tkachenko 2014 (PRC 89 045206) entry. EG1b (eid 95, 146) is there as g1, A1, g1/F1, Gamma_1 etc. -- inclusive, no spectator. The only spectator-momentum distribution for a deuteron target in the database is Deeps (eid 90; Klimenko et al., PRC 73 (2006) 035212, nucl-ex/0510032): F2N x P(p_s, cos theta_pq) at p_s = 300-560 MeV/c -- vendored separately in clas_deeps_klimenko2006_f2P.json.
